args: 2025 Revenue Reconciliation via Ledger Accounts, Including VAT, by Quarter
Once VAT/sales-tax is included on the ledger side (not just net-of-tax revenue), does the ledger's gross billed amount tie to the payments table's net captured amount each quarter?

{"run": "run6", "manager": "cfo", "analyst": "Kofi Mensah", "engineer": "Ines", "situation": "year-end-audit", "week": 2, "night": 4, "request": 1, "grain": "one calendar quarter, 2025", "columns_requested": ["quarter", "ledger_gross_billed_eur (sum of credit amounts where ledger_accounts.account_type='revenue' OR ledger_accounts.name='VAT / sales tax payable', minus sum of debit amounts where ledger_accounts.account_type='contra_revenue' OR ledger_accounts.name='VAT / sales tax payable', all for ledger_entries.occurred_at in the quarter)", "payments_net_amount_eur (sum of payments.amount - payments.amount_refunded, captured_at in the quarter, status captured/refunded/partially_refunded)", "diff_eur", "diff_pct"], "details": "Same method as last night's revenue reconciliation report (EUR conversion per-row via exchange_rates on the ledger entry's own occurred_at/currency_code for the ledger side, and on captured_at/currency_code for the payments side), but this time include the 'VAT / sales tax payable' ledger account's credits (at capture) and debits (at refund reversal) in the ledger-side total alongside 'revenue'-type accounts and 'contra_revenue'-type debits, so the ledger total represents the full gross-billed-minus-refunded amount rather than tax-exclusive revenue. Group by calendar quarter of occurred_at (ledger side) / captured_at (payments side). Order chronologically 2025-Q1 to 2025-Q4 (4 rows).", "builds_on": ["2025 Revenue Reconciliation via Correct Ledger Accounts, by Quarter"]}
